What does 'PoE power budget exceeded' mean?
The total power requested by PoE devices is more than the switch can supply
What happens when a PoE switch's power budget is exceeded?
Some devices may not receive power or may be shut off by priority
A PoE switch has a 370 W budget and devices needing 400 W total. What is the result?
The switch cannot power all devices; some are denied power
Which action helps resolve a PoE power budget problem?
Reduce device count, use a higher-budget switch, or add power
What is an incorrect PoE standard mismatch?
A device needs more power than the switch's PoE standard provides

How much power does 802.3at (PoE+) provide per port at the source?

The device may not power on or may be unstable due to insufficient power

A new 802.3bt camera won't power on from an older PoE+ switch. What is the MOST likely cause?
The switch's PoE standard provides less power than the device needs

What is a transceiver (SFP/SFP+) in networking?
A modular component that converts signals for fiber or copper connections
Using incompatible transceivers or types on the two ends of a link

What does low transceiver signal strength indicate?
Possible dirty connectors, excessive distance, or a failing transceiver
Which tool reads optical signal levels from a transceiver?
Digital optical monitoring (DOM) or an optical power meter
A single-mode transceiver is plugged into multimode fiber. What is the likely result?
A link failure or high loss due to fiber type mismatch
Which practice helps avoid transceiver mismatches?
Using matching transceiver types, speeds, and wavelengths on both ends
Which symptom suggests a transceiver is failing rather than a cable fault?
Degrading optical levels reported by DOM over time
A switch reports 'power budget exceeded' after adding new APs. What is the BEST first step?
Calculate total PoE demand versus the switch budget
Which practice helps plan PoE deployments?
Summing device power needs and choosing a switch with adequate budget
A device negotiates PoE but keeps rebooting under load. What is the MOST likely cause?
Insufficient power from an incorrect PoE standard or budget
Which practice helps diagnose a transceiver issue?
Swapping the transceiver with a known-good matching unit
Which issue is indicated when both ends use compatible transceivers but the fiber is dirty?
High loss causing link errors or failure
A PoE camera 90 meters away works, but one at 100+ meters doesn't. What is the cause?
Power loss over the longer cable combined with distance limits
Which practice helps resolve a PoE standard mismatch?
Upgrading the switch, using an injector, or choosing a compatible device
Which transceiver characteristic must match for a link to work?
Which symptom indicates a transceiver signal strength problem on a long fiber run?
Rising input errors and low received optical power
A switch supports 802.3bt but a device only draws PoE power. Is this a problem?
No, higher-capable switches can power lower-requirement devices
Which practice helps avoid PoE budget surprises when scaling up?
Monitoring PoE usage and leaving headroom
Which transceiver issue would cause intermittent fiber link drops?
A marginal or failing transceiver, or dirty connectors
Which tool helps verify fiber connector cleanliness?
A device needs 25 W but the switch provides only 802.3af power. What should be done?
Use an 802.3at or bt switch/injector that provides enough power
Which practice helps when a transceiver is not recognized by a switch?
Verifying it is a supported, compatible type for that switch
Which symptom suggests a copper SFP is used where fiber is needed or vice versa?
The link won't establish due to media mismatch
Which practice helps document PoE and transceiver deployments?
Recording device power needs, switch budgets, and transceiver types
A fiber transceiver shows high loss only on one strand. What should be checked?
That strand's connectors and the transceiver's TX/RX alignment
Which practice helps avoid powering issues when mixing PoE devices?
Ensuring the switch's total and per-port budgets meet all demands
Which hardware issue would cause a PoE phone to lose power when a space heater is on the same circuit?
A power/circuit problem rather than a network issue
Which practice helps confirm a transceiver is the fault, not the fiber?
Testing the fiber with a light source and swapping the transceiver
Which transceiver spec determines the maximum fiber distance?
The optical type and power budget (e.g., SR, LR)
A 10GBASE-SR transceiver is used over a 10 km run. What is the problem?
SR is short-reach and won't span 10 km; LR is needed
Which practice helps prevent transceiver signal problems?
Keeping connectors clean and within distance and loss limits
Which symptom indicates a PoE device is being denied power due to priority?
Lower-priority devices lose power when the budget is tight
Which practice helps troubleshoot a transceiver link that flaps?
Checking optical levels, cleaning connectors, and swapping the transceiver
Which hardware consideration applies when connecting two switches with fiber?
Both transceivers must match in type, speed, and wavelength
Which practice helps avoid PoE and transceiver issues during installation?
Verifying device power requirements and transceiver compatibility beforehand
Which BEST summarizes PoE and transceiver hardware issues?
PoE problems come from exceeding the power budget or using the wrong standard, and transceiver problems come from mismatched types or poor signal strength
